name: Montornès del Vallès (Spain)
description: Green field with a red Scandinavian cross fimbriated white crossing in the first third, and the yellow castle of the arms closed in red in the upper hoist.
history: The flag was approved on 26 January 1994 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, green, with a red Scandinavian cross crossing in the first third, 1/9 of the height wide, over another white cross of 1/6, and at the hoist the castle of the arms (blazon approved by decree of 23 December 1965), yellow closed in red, 1/4 of the height.
